name: pixel-heading-word
title: Pixel Heading Word
description: A heading set in a pixel typeface that changes face as a pointer rests on it: either cycling through five pixel styles every few hundred milliseconds, or swapping once to a hover style, with the style name in a small label.
useWhen: A headline should flip between pixel-font personalities for a retro or technical feel.
A product or game title that needs a typographic wink.
avoidWhen: Body copy or long sentences: pixel faces are wide and hard to read at length.
Letters should change one by one: use pixel-heading-character.
author: Cult UI
